text: Appeal of Order to Comply (December 9, 2021) for 69 Riverview Gardens.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Deferred consideration of the Order to Comply (December 9, 2021) for 69 Riverview Gardens, Folder Number: 21 245429 PRS 00 IV, to its meeting on June 13, 2022. 2. If the City of Toronto has access to the high resolution, CAD file used to produce the survey that was used by Municipal Licensing and Standards in issuing the Order to Comply, the City will produce the CAD file to the appellants.
